releaseNotes: v8.12.1: ⚧ Context / Dynamic (M/F) Adaptive Gender Lock & AI Lore Engine. Adds first-class support for characters whose gender changes/transitions dynamically across the story (e.g. Bai Ning Bing, Trissy, Lumian Lee). Injects adaptive translation directives preventing forced rigid pronouns while maintaining situational accuracy. Supports [M/F], (m/f), [both] glossary markers, 3-way toggle badges (♀ Female → ♂ Male → ⚧ Context), and AI classification.
